guide.myriad.title: MYRIAD Handbook
guide.myriad.page1:
Welcome to MYRIAD, a fair team-based MOBA with heroes from many genres. Choose 5v5 three-lane or 3v3 single-lane battles.

Destroy three towers in any enemy lane to unlock their crystal. Destroy the crystal to win. Results are announced before everyone returns to the lobby.
guide.myriad.page2: Draft: the opening side picks one hero, then each side takes two picks in turn. Right-click portraits to learn more. Picks are unique and time out automatically.
guide.myriad.page3:
Growth and skills

Earn gold and XP from minions, monsters and heroes. Gain one skill point per level; open your Info panel to learn and upgrade skills.

Reworked heroes cap at level 20 and use skill branches and gold-purchased attributes. Other heroes retain their existing progression and equipment.
guide.myriad.page4: First wave at 1:10, then every 40 seconds. Push with minions to avoid tower backdoor protection. Jungle Blade costs 450 gold and grants 30% bonus monster damage.
guide.myriad.page5: Start with 500 gold. Buy within 10 blocks of your base or while waiting to respawn. B channels recall. Leaving base grants +250% movement speed for 8 seconds, canceled by combat.
guide.myriad.page6: Share nearby vision with teammates. Brush conceals enemies. Purchase vision totems and right-click to place within 6 blocks. Allies have colored names; enemy names are hidden.
guide.myriad.page7: Respawn time is level times two plus seven seconds. Follow living teammates while waiting and shop freely. Enemy players are hidden. Reincarnation revives at the death location after 3 seconds.
guide.myriad.page8: Capture Moon, Fire and Wood veins during the first ten minutes for 5% team spell power, physical attack or defense and periodic gold/XP. Large veins are disabled. Push lanes and group before objectives.
hero.guide.yingxiao: Study your skill ranges below, preserve an escape or defensive skill, and coordinate with allies. Practice the hero's recasts and aim in training before committing to fights.
hero.guide.xuanchen: Study your skill ranges below, preserve an escape or defensive skill, and coordinate with allies. Practice the hero's recasts and aim in training before committing to fights.

hero.guide.hanze: 冰霜控场前排。叠霜定身或周期护盾二选一；用冰锥远程消耗、霜盾承伤，主要和终极可选择控区或团队保护。没有旧版最大生命真实伤害。
hero.guide.lingyuan: 御剑压制战士。普攻养剑或施法蓄势二选一；两种终极分别是大范围持续剑雨、蓄力贯穿巨剑。注意飞剑不会无限提速或穿透，法力仍限制施法。
hero.guide.qingluo: 治疗与保护辅助。仁心擅长救低血队友，药露擅长先攻击后治疗。丹阵保护一块区域，渡厄保护单个队友；终极可选持续恢复或即时群体护盾。
hero.guide.chixiao: 突进与反打的重刃战士。断岳斩是前方扇形攻击，追魂踏有一次返回；主要选招架反打或刀罡消耗。战意附加伤害与强化普攻均由智慧增强，不提供旧全能吸血。
hero.guide.yunsheng: 灵契支援辅助。弧线纸鹤能攻击敌人或治疗友军，定契索隔墙/超距即断；用界标守区或护行支援，终极可选引导回响域或即时护盾加速。

hero.guide.shuo: A melee draw-cut specialist. Build edge while sheathed, find an opening, draw and resheathe. Left-click remains a vanilla single-target melee attack. Right-click while drawn to resheathe (0.4s attack lock). Flash/Three Crescents favor initiation; Perfect Read/Sheath Reversal reward timing. Dashes do not pass through walls.

skill.myriad.leijiezhan.desc: After 0.5s charge (lightning gathers to your front), swing out a crescent sword-qi that flies 15 blocks per second for 1.2s (18 blocks total), dealing 10+80% AD physical damage to enemies it hits and slowing them 30% for 2s

Arrays last 8s, up to 2 pairs. Right-clicking an array teleports you to its bound partner (aiming at an array highlights its bound target; 2s shared cooldown)

After confirming, channel for 1s (particles rise from you), then particles fall at the target for 1s before the zone unfolds; the zone lasts 5s: allies get 30% damage reduction and +15% speed, enemies are slowed 30%

skill.myriad.lieyanzhan.desc: Sweep a 120-degree arc of fire (5-block radius) centered on you, dealing 14+50% AD physical damage and burning enemies for 10% AD true damage every 0.5s over 3s

skill.myriad.yike_rainbow_mark.desc: 付费主动对同一英雄有效命中三次，造成40＋10(r－1)＋20%S魔法伤害；每次付费施法只记一层，最后命中6秒后清空。
skill.myriad.yike_steady_barrier.desc: 最近连续1.2秒水平累计路程不超过0.3格，下一次成功提交主动获得65＋15(r－1)＋25%S护盾2.5秒；真实内置冷却12秒。
skill.myriad.yike_rainbow_shell.desc: 起手0.25秒可50%移动，出膛才耗35蓝并起冷却。16格、30格每秒、扫掠0.35格，1.5格爆炸造成95＋18(r－1)＋55%S魔法伤害。
skill.myriad.yike_refraction_denial.desc: 14格合法地面布下2.5格预警，0.55秒后造成70＋18(r－1)＋35%S魔法伤害、减速30%持续1.25秒。取消待发Q，恢复50%移速并暂停下一炮0.55秒。
skill.myriad.yike_fixed_artillery.desc: 0.45秒成功展开才缴费；定身最多6秒，手动Q最多5发，每炮35蓝、26格、34格每秒、当前Q的65%至80%伤害，最短出膛间隔1.10秒。
skill.myriad.yike_mobile_array.desc: 0.35秒成功展开才缴费；70%移动且不能疾跑，6秒内手动Q最多4发，每炮35蓝、20格、30格每秒、当前Q的55%至70%伤害，1格爆炸，间隔1.35秒。
skill.myriad.yike_distant_bombardment.de: 26格可见合法地面，开始0.60秒定身蓄势即缴费；抛物线飞行至少0.40秒，撞墙消散。4格爆炸每目标一次250＋85(r－1)＋115%S魔法伤害。
skill.myriad.yike_prismatic_beam.desc: 开始0.60秒定身蓄势即缴费，随后真实3秒六跳。22格、全宽1.25格、每秒45度炮口追随，遇墙截止，每跳70＋20(r－1)＋25%S魔法伤害。再按终极主动取消。
